book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yesu qandi lek veil meyeing
Lek bouk ti myaxeeng wei sounda tiyon satiboukeing lul, eno xel vex qou lulul wei xeimangou wei xel menyex wou yo me la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei.
Xel yei qakous wei xel lax zeyi leiveeng meyeing eno xel tatekexe veil leiveeng meyeing mya.
Ekom gyeik ingwei xel la lalei eno xel se yei Tambiy Ngandoung Yesu neing.
Ka xel di wou naleind ngenong en inyon, lutika eno xel yei tambiy yayuw xe teimb on siing niseikeing nambei zivip me toukale wou xel wes.
Xel vex yaleeng me ev vaxendkatu eivek de mend la tembuing, ekom moux yuw on neil wou xel, “Xam ghe lam di wimexe tambiy wei mapieing o eivek beyeeng wei meyeing o en va?
Moxo se toundei inye, qe qandi lek! Xam ghe bou naleimim en qayeeng wei neil wou xam, gyeik nanghei toundei is xam eivek Galili yo.
Neil embei, ‘Tyek xel a toung Xomaxoneing Neu Moux na eivek xel wei sewokeing o memend, en xel atuw e lek xax pepeeng de bouk yal na veil, ond tyek qandi lek no.’”
Woyom xel wou naleind en Yesu xe qayeeng wei neil o.
Gyeik ingwei xel loum veil leiveeng meyeing eno xel neil lulti beimambei yon wou xel betiyeing xoumeeng ti me moux alis vex dalus.
Xel vex wei neil lulti beimambei yon wou sinaleyeiw eno inye, Maria wei Makdala yo, me Joana, me Maria wei Jems ta yo, me vex valu is xel.
Ekom xel se wongis xel vex on, en xel xe qayeeng on wong ambei lul bandaing.
Ekom Petele qandi lek me veimya me la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei. Dundek me yeila lalei, ekom qaeing toundei bandaing. Moxo lox me la beeng, de venaxow di wounalei bei inye vati wong ambei nye.
Moux yayuw di luk is Yesu wou sakwaing Emaus
Lek bouk kayon eno Yesu xe xel betiyeing yayuw la beyeeng tiwei xel mi neil Emaus nei. Inyon nambei 11 kilomita nanghei Yerusalem.
Luw di la me luk wou ma en lul sapa wei qandi natax o.
Ka luw di luk wouma en lulul ti beimambei yon, eno Yesu venaxow la tyip me di tupwou sakwaing is luw.
Ekom lulti wong luw se yeimend wou bei inyon Yesu.
Moxo teling luw, “Muw ghe tupwou sakwaing eno muw ghe di luklek vati wouma me ghe lam?” Luw nale me mend talex lek bei luw laleind pyaxow.
Tambiy yuw on eno nge wei lei Kliopas, eno teling e, “Wa tambiy tixemou yon ghe la bei beyeeng amba eivek Yerusalem eno wa seng woulek vati wei qandi nanghei inyei lek bouk senghoing tine yo?”

Yesu teling luw, “Lul vatiyeiw?” Luw neil elox bei, “Uw andi luk en Yesu wei Nasaret o, moxo poropet ti, mi neil xoulek nikanzek me mi wong lulvako wou Anutu manghalus me xomaxoneing dalus mendghalus is.
Xel lumuki leitata yo me xe xe gyovaxa toung e la eivek seyap memend me xel wong qayeeng en me neil embei e mey, om xel tuw e lek xax pepeeng,
ekom xa di toung mami en moxo en inyon e tambiy tiwei Anutu wong e lam bei e nam a tul e xe xel Israel veil nilul o. Me lulti is no, inye bouk yal la veil en ingwei lulul tiyon dalus qandi yo.
De gweimbeeng xel vex wei xa eno valu wong xa etek. En xel la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei satiboukeing lul,
ekom xel se yei e neing. Xel loum neil wou xa bei, xel mend pekwi me xel yei angelayeiw wei neil embei moxo toundei mapieing.
Woyom xel wei xa eno valu la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei, me la yei lul toundei nambei ingwei vex vex neil o. Ekom xel se yei e.”
Yesu neil wou luw bei, “Muw ghe loung om muw naleimim se qandi lek daing me ghe wongis qayeeng dalus wei xel poropet neil o.
Beip Kilisi se teyei bei qou myavanei beimambei ne, dekakom na qou lei ngandoung is xeiyaing?”
Woyom neil myaxeeng wou luw en xoulek dalus wei Mose, me xel poropet o me veil luw lundlek en xoulek qes dalus wei xel neil lek e venaxow eivek xoulek o.
Ka lal la paviy beyeeng tiwei luw embei na yo, woyom Yesu wong ambei embeim di na.
Ekom luw neilaxoun e me neil embei, “Wa toumendei inye is uw en inye paviy soukeing, me inye embim a bouk.” Om moxo eivek la xomek lalei me la toundei is luw.
Gyeik ingwei Yesu la dei lek lelek is luw, moxo qou belet me wong dange wou Anutu, de dembu me embei mouk bong wou luw.
Woyom luw mend yeila me luw yeimend wou e, de moxo malang veil luw mend.
Luw neil wouma bei, “Qayeeng wei neil eno nyuw uw laleind gyeik ingwei e di luk is uw wou sakwaing me veil uw lundlek en Anutu xe xoulek qes o.”
De luti eno luw qandi lek me lox me la Yerusalem. Nanghei inyei eno luw yeiwou xel betiyeing xoumeeng ti is moux alis vex valu di qekuma me dei.
Xel neil wou luw bei, “Inye zonghek ayang Tambiy Ngandoung qandi lek! Moxo talex xow wou Simon.”
Woyom luw neil wou xel en vati wei qandi wou luw wou sakwaing o, me ingwei luw yeimend wou Yesu gyeik ingwei dembu belet o.
Yesu talex xow wou xel betiyeing
Ka xel betiyeing nanghei di luk wouma en tine, eno Yesu venaxow lam nale eivek xel senghoing me neil wou xel, “Lalei vevopeing e mi mendei is xam.”
Om xel etek me yaleeng en xel embeik nge xel yei meyeing ti nu.
Moxo neil wou xel bei, “Xam ghe etek en va? Me xam laleimim wo yuw en va?
Wei lam a memang luw xouing me a vaxang luw xouing. Inye a venaxow o! Xam axlek ay me wei. Meyeing nu eno leyeis me kanzek ma, se nambei ingwei xam ghe wei lek a ne.”
Gyeik ingwei moxo neil ambei nye, eno talex mema luw me vaxa luw wou xel.
Dekakom xel seng ghei wongis. En nambei xel wo xeindlala me di wou naleind ngenong, moxo teling wou xel, “Xam ghe di qou lul yaeing valu nanghei inye?”
Xel wong woing wei nekeing eno danghei ti wou e,
de moxo zeim me ya wou xel mendghalus.

Moxo neil wou xel, “Inye vati wei a neil wou xam gyeik ingwei anghei toundei is xam o, lul sapa wei xel byex lek ay eivek Mose xe petieing, me xel poropet xe qapiya, me qapiya lalo, eno embo neing lek.”
Woyom moxo veil xel lundlek bei xel boulek xoulek qes wei di yeip eivek qapiya vambuing o.
Moxo neil wou xel bei, “Inye vati wei xel byex eivek xoulek o, Kilisi tyek na qou myavanei me na mey de qandi lek veil meyeing lek bouk yal.
De eivek e lei eno xel a neil xoulek wou xomaxoneing wei tembuing tambak o en xel pekwi xow, me Anutu semaleeng sewokeing wei xel o. Xam ghe bong xuk tiyon nanghei Yerusalem a tax.
Xam on ingwei xam ghe wei mamim wou lulti beimambei ne dalus woy.
Tyek a na bong lul vati wei mang neil zonghek o wou xam, ekom xam a mi mendei eivek Yerusalem deka xam a qou nikanzek wei Anutu gheyapu yo bole.”
Yesu lek me la tyoung gheyapu nei
Gyeik Yesu qou xel betiyeing me la beyeeng Betani nei. Moxo zeim mema luw xouing lek la de wong mata wou xel.
Ka e di wong mata wou xel eno moxo la veil xel, de Anutu qou e me la eivek tyoung gheyapu nei.
Woyom xel wong lalo wou e, de lox me la Yerusalem is xeindlala ngandoung.
De taxombouk eno xel mindei eivek xomek vambuing me sanghoxe Anutu.
